description: This file is a shell script that defines a series of tests for the Git rebase functionality, specifically testing behaviors related to the rebase todo list, editing, and modifications during rebase.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines individual test cases with descriptive labels, managing setup and verification steps in the testing process.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new git commit with specified file content, used for setting up the repository state before tests.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a shell script file with specified content for use during testing.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to output or expected files to facilitate comparison in tests.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Configures a fake editor environment for scripted rebase interactions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or strings to verify test conditions.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
